summary: An Electron desktop app that runs multi-agent workflows defined in YAML, each agent turn a headless CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Grok). Layers: shared pure modules at the bottom, the run engine and the product logic in the middle, the service channels and the renderer on top; bundled skills and workflows are product content.

zones.name: Shared foundations
zones.purpose: Pure modules loaded by both the backend and the page: types, models, provider and platform adapters.

zones.name: Native sidecars
zones.purpose: Rust binaries the packaged app ships: the supervisor's MCP server, the session tail and the control client.

zones.name: Run engine
zones.purpose: The deterministic engine that walks a workflow graph, runs agent turns and machine steps, and records every event.

zones.name: Product logic
zones.purpose: What the app does around runs: roadmap and backlog, the Oracle and the supervisor, costs and records, the workspace.

zones.name: App entry and service
zones.purpose: The Electron main process, the engine server and the service channels that connect the page to everything else.

zones.name: Renderer
zones.purpose: The screens the owner works in: the shell, every view, the run's 3D floor and the styles.

zones.name: Dev tooling
zones.purpose: Scripts for building, packaging, docs, screenshots and the code-health ratchets.

zones.name: Bundled content
zones.purpose: The skills and workflow definitions seeded into every workspace.

zones.name: Tests
zones.purpose: Unit, service, slow and contract tests, fixtures and the BDD scenarios.

districts.name: Service tests
